name: What does shower removal cost, and what makes the price go up?
description: Pricing depends on demo scope, labor, materials, and hidden repairs; in this area, many projects land around $1,000 to $5,000.

mainEntity.name: What does shower removal cost, and what makes the price go up?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost depends on what is being removed, how much prep is needed, and whether you are replacing the shower immediately. Local Denver-area shower replacement projects commonly fall in a broad range from about $1,000 to $5,000, with labor, materials, and extra plumbing or waterproofing work affecting the total.
